notes.omweso: Coro is the Acholi board game played with seeds in holes.

guidebook.intro: Free time means football, music, dance and games of **coro**.

tips.title: Yom cwinya ki…
body: Say what you enjoy with **Yom cwinya ki** (my heart is sweet with): **Yom cwinya ki kwano buk** (I enjoy reading books). **Amaro** (I like, I love) works too: **Amaro odilo**.

tips.title: Waloyo! We won!
body: **Loyo** is to beat or win: **Waloyo!** (we won!), **Kilub mera oloyo** (my team has won), **Nga ma oloyo?** (who has won?). When you lose, **giloyowa** (they beat us).

culture.title: Larakaraka and bwola
body: Acholi dances are famous: **larakaraka**, danced by young people at courtship gatherings, and **bwola**, the royal dance of the chiefs with its big drums.
